component.name: mRemoteNG
component.summary: Manage SSH, RDP, VNC, SFTP and other connections in one window

description.p: mRemoteNG for Linux keeps your remote connections in a tree and opens them in tabs: SSH, Telnet, Rlogin, raw TCP, PowerShell and local terminal sessions, remote desktops (RDP through FreeRDP, VNC and Apple Remote Desktop), and SFTP and FTP/FTPS file transfers. Web addresses, AnyDesk and SPICE consoles of Proxmox VE and QEMU virtual machines open in their own window.

Its connection files are those of mRemoteNG for Windows, so a team can share one file between Windows and Linux, including its encrypted passwords. SSH uses OpenSSH, so your ssh_config, keys, agent and known_hosts apply.
This is a community port of mRemoteNG to Linux; it is not made by the mRemoteNG project.
First beta release. Connection files are shared with Windows mRemoteNG 1.77 and later, encrypted passwords included, and the app looks like mRemoteNG for Windows.

ul.li: Terminal tabs: SSH (OpenSSH), Telnet, Rlogin, raw TCP, PowerShell and local shells
Remote desktop tabs: RDP through FreeRDP 3, and VNC and Apple Remote Desktop with a built-in viewer
SFTP and FTP/FTPS file transfer tabs
Web addresses in the browser, AnyDesk, and SPICE consoles of Proxmox VE and QEMU virtual machines
SSH tunnels, external tools, Wake-on-LAN and the servers' status in the connection tree
